Text: God, through the humility of Your Son, You have elevated all of creation. [t] Lavish holy joy upon Your faithful, [*] for You freed all of us from our slavery to sin. Continue to invite us into undying joyy
Changes: 2026-07-05 - Paul Prins: Made the relationship to sin personal.
